Name: Sweet Farmer - Cuter and Shorter Body CP-FS
Author: HeartOfFlowers
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53548/53548-1792021799-1270778775.png[/img][/center]
[center][color=#444444][size=1][i]Captions: "Sweet Farmer: Cuter body with customizable height!" Showing many farmers with different heights and appearances.
[/i][/size][/color][size=6][font=Courier New][b][i]
Sweet Farmer
[/i][/b][/font][/size]
[left]Hi ! This mod has been under development for a year, and in said year I managed to fit many features into it. It started as me being unhappy with the fact that we can't chose our height in-game, and that not many body types are represented. I plan to add far more options in the future so everyone can be reflected in the game! If you want to use Fashion Sense, I posted a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53551]Fashion Sense Pack[/url] for this farmer! [/left]
[left]
[b][i][size=4]List of features:[/size][/i][/b]
[list]
[*]5 Different height configs! (4 in vanilla, 5 with Fashion Sense)[/*]
[*]4 Different arm types: 'Sharp' for stronger farmers, 'Sweet' is great for everyone, 'Tender' for shorter and more delicate farmers, and 'Squishy' for the adorable farmers![/*]
[*]8 Different sleeve types that automatically adapt to your arm type![/*]
[*]4 Different shoes, with extra configs such as gap fills and tips![/*]
[*]5 Different sock heights that you can combine with your shoes and pants! (Or you can just leave them disabled!)[/*]
[*]2 Different torsos: Sweet, which includes a visible chest, and Gender Neutral, which shows a flat chest! (Match your shirts accordingly!)[/*]
[*]Shirt replacements, for the moment only for the initial 112 in the character creator![/*]
[*]Hair replacements with 5 different undertones (Neutral, Pink, Golden, Mint and Purple), so your hair will always be vibrant regardless of your colors of choice![/*]
[*]6 Different eye types: Sweet, Sharp, Sleepy, Silly, Asleep and Tasty![/*]
[*]Many makeup options! Optional nose, sclera color, 13 eyelashes colors, eye depth, and even eyeshadows exclusive for the "Tasty" eye type![/*]
[*]Optional top surgery scars![/*]
[*]Unique 2-piece swimsuits that let you pick your top and bottom! [/*]
[*]2 Different instruments to pick, the Mini Harp and the brand new Violin![/*]
[*]4 Different shadow types to match your farmer height; optionally you can disable it for a flying effect! (Or co-op!)[/*]
[*]The Fashion Sense torsos come with eyes, eyelashes, sclera and swimsuits that are 100% dyable![/*]
[/list]This mod works best with Fashion Sense! Although it's not a requirement.[/left]
[/center]


[center][b][i][color=#e06666][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/color][/i][/b][/center]
[list]
[*]"Compatible" with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] farmer. In case you didn't know, this mod includes a farmer, Sweet Farmer replaces it entirely, so you don't [i]need[/i] to disable it. Since it's a replacement, you won't be able to have both farmers![/*]
[*]It's [i][b]technically compatible with other farmers,[/b][/i] and by that I mean that if you install the CP version the 2 farmers will fight to see who gets shown. This will cause bugs! You can disable my farmer with the simple toggle on the top, you can still have the skin colors if you do that. [/*]
[*]For [b]Fashion Sense bodies,[/b] If you want to mix 2 bodies together [b]you can[/b], but this will cause bugs, inconsistencies, and if you swap the shoes you won't even be short.[/*]
[/list][center][color=#f6b26b][b][i][size=5]Installation[/size][/i][/b][/color][/center]
[b][size=4]For the Content Patcher version: [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Install Content Patcher [/b][/*]
[*]Download, extract and drop it into your mod folder like any other mod.[/*]
[*][b]CHECK THE CONFIGS![/b] This mod requires you to mess around with the configs until you find what makes you comfortable![/*]
[*]Check the "VISUAL GUIDE" folder inside (Or this mod page!) to understand all the configs.[/*]
[*]Clothes can be found in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53551]Sweet Fashion [/url]mod.
[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]For the Fashion Sense Version [/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url].[/b][/*]
[*]Install the Fashion Sense (FS) version of this mod, the "Visual guide" is still useful for this mod.[/*]
[*][b][size=3]Install the Content Patcher Version of the mod![/size][/b][size=3] This mod is not recommended as a standalone, Fashion sense doesn't allow configs, therefore most of the configs such as swimsuits and face make up will be missing. I recommend using the FS for easy swaps or Seasonal outfits. [/size][/*]
[*][size=3]The visual guide is useful for this version too.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Clothes can be found in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53551]Sweet Fashion[/url] mod.[/size]
[/*]
[/list][center][color=#444444][size=1][i]I did in fact not get asked all of these, but most of these I got already![/i][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#d5a6bd][b][i][size=5]FAQ - click the spoiler if you're lost![/size][/i][/b][/color][/center]
[spoiler][b][color=#b4a7d6]WHY IS MY FARMER BLUE / DIFFERENT SKIN COLOR?[/color]
[/b]
[list]
[*]Do not panic! Simply go to mod configs, at the top there should be my farmer, "(CP) A Sweet Farmer", click, you'll see at the top the skin color options, select "Vanilla", [i]now since you're there[/i], configure your farmer properly :D (Yes, that's why it comes on by default, sorry not sorry!) [/*]
[/list][b][color=#b4a7d6]I want my farmer to go lighter than the default vanilla skin color / I'm trying to make a unique skin color in the FS version [/color][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51901][b]"The Infinity Tones" has your back, my friend[/b][/url][/*]
[/list][b][color=#b4a7d6]I can't find socks in the Fashion Sense version...[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Currently trying to figure out a layout and how to implement them since there is no configs, most likely I'll end up using accessories as shoe layers. Meanwhile, be patient![/*]
[/list][b][color=#b4a7d6]I'm struggling to understand what version of the mod I need![/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]First, figure out which of these scenarios is you![/b][/*]
[*][b]You want to use ONLY the Short torso:[/b] Install the CP version then! The FS version is optional[/*]
[*][b]You want to use ONLY the Long torso:[/b] Don't even bother installing the CP version unless you want vanilla shirts and pants, install the FS version![/*]
[*][b]You don't like going to the config menu so often: [/b]Install the FS version then.[/*]
[*][b]Some days you would prefer having a visible chest, some days you want to have a flat chest:[/b] Both versions will do nicely! For easy swap, FS version is the best choice.[/*]
[*][b]You want to use both torsos depending on the day / I'm planning to play co-op:[/b] Install both versions! Configure the CP farmer to a neutral point or to a body type similar to what all players want (mostly), the ones that need different configs can use the Fashion Sense version to make themselves feel comfortable![/*]
[*][b]You want to use another farmer, but your co-op friend wants to use the Sweet farmer: [/b]DO NOT INSTALL THE CP VERSION! Make sure all players install the FS version, let your friend the shorty be the different one, the rest of you enjoy the tall privileges. (This also work if your fellow players want a visible chest), if the floating shadow bothers any of you I recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39410]No Farmer Shadow[/url], note that the Sweet Farmer users will need clothes made for their body. (Just like in real life!)[/*]
[/list][b][color=#b4a7d6]Help! When I equip the Fashion Sense torsos, the arms and legs of my farmer disappear![/color]
[/b]
[list]
[*]That should happen! Go to the "Sleeves" section on FS, search for the arm + sleeve you want.[/*]
[*]Now, go to the "Boots" section, repeat, there's an available tip accessory, simply match it with your torso + leg height (trust the process!)[/*]
[*]Why did I code it like that? It's so you wouldn't have wide hips if you didn't want them when I add the Slim version of the legs in the future, and so you can truly pick ANY leg height you want [/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][b]How to I equip the long torso?[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Inside the mirror, go to body, select the "Long Torso - Sweet / Neutral", adjust skintone, with the color layers you can color your eyes, sclera, eyebrows and more![/*]
[*]Go to "Sleeves" select the sleeves and arm type you want. [/*]
[*]Go to "Accessories" and select "Shoulders Fix Long Torso" to have your arms match your new height.[/*]
[*]Go to "Boots" and select your desired height + shoes! There are currently no socks available![/*]
[*]If you want a nose, a tip for your shoes, etc, just go to accessories and find all of those.[/*]
[/list][color=#b4a7d6][b]Does this FS pack work with your mod?[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]I don't know! Read the known issues, if you think it may work, try it out! There's too many FS packs for me to manually test each one, so rely on the Discord community and the comments to find what works. I'll assemble a list, one day.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#b4a7d6]Can you adapt this FS pack to work with your mod?[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Probably not. This would require me to first get permission, which is unlikely given that many FS authors are first time modders or abandoned modding as a hobby already. If it's an open permission pack, maybe. But I will always prioritize original content for my farmer.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][color=#3c78d8][size=5][font=Courier New][b][i]Known issues[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Not all Fashion Sense packs will look good. [/b]Due to how small the torso is most shirts don't fit properly, the arm and leg animations have been completely re-made for this mod to work and be unique. This means shirts, pants, sleeves and some other items won't align properly or look as intended. There is a fashion sense pack published for this mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53551]Sweet Fashion[/url], you'll surely find something for you in there![/*]
[*]All FS and CP hairs that aren't made for the Sweet Farmer will have missing pixels, in the Sweet Fashion pack you'll be able to find a Hair Gap Fixer with different variations for the length of your hair, you have to color match it but it works fine![/*]
[*]The vanilla shirts have extra fabric on the sides of the front facing torso only visible when the farmer raises their arms (Mining, carrying, harvest, etc), making it look like your torso is one pixel wider on each side, this won't be visible while you walk at all. This is because of how the vanilla sleeves work, unfortunately I can't change this for the moment. I'll consider commissioning a C# programmer to check if we can change this at all, for now the solution is to use Fashion sense shirts for the Sweet Farmer.[/*]
[*]The pants, just like in real life, don't adapt to the height of the legs. That is not a bug, simply grab a longer pant or use boots to make it fit better![/*]
[*]Tall legs need to be used with specific arms to look decent, but even so the torso looks small. This gets solved by using Fashion Sense's longer torso which automatically adapts all the pants designed for the Sweet Farmer into the proper height, and it's the best looking option for the tall farmer. There's a special variation of the shirts for the long torso! (Tysm Viki!) You need to use the "Shoulders Fix Long Torso" accessory and match it to your sleeve color. (Long arms coming!)[/*]
[*]There's no long torso config in the Content Patcher version, this is not a bug, this is intended. Adding a long torso config would be a nightmare for me, sorry! Maybe once I get a proper break I'll consider it![/*]
[*]If you have questions, bugs or suggestions please join my [url=https://discord.gg/GqgZB5cmJp]Discord Server[/url] or comment them here! I plant to make a FAQ with your help![/*]
[/list][center][color=#ead1dc][size=6][font=Courier New][b][i]Special thanks to...[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
